kernel.shape: each simdgroup covers 16x16 as a 2x2 grid of 8x8 tiles

result.hypothesis_tested: The previous receipt diagnosed MLX's advantage at 2048 as HIERARCHICAL BLOCKING and operand reuse rather than simdgroup ops, since MLX already had those. That was a falsifiable claim, so it was tested: give each simdgroup a 2x2 grid of 8x8 tiles so 4 operand loads feed 4 MACs instead of 2 loads feeding 1, doubling arithmetic intensity and changing nothing else.

hypothesis_confirmed.verdict: the diagnosis held; the gap really was operand reuse

block2_vs_block1.reason: an arm failed the 10.0% IQR gate (block1 7.38%, block2 26.55%) and the margin 7.62% does not overwhelm that noise

block2_vs_mlx.reason: an arm failed the 10.0% IQR gate (mlx 70.14%, block2 26.55%) and the margin 2.63% does not overwhelm that noise

block2_vs_block1.caveat: an arm exceeded the 10.0% IQR gate, but the margin is 6x the worst arm noise, so the direction of the result is not in doubt; the MAGNITUDE carries more uncertainty than a clean measurement would

block2_vs_mlx.reason: an arm failed the 10.0% IQR gate (mlx 2.8%, block2 19.89%) and the margin 49.52% does not overwhelm that noise
margin 3.97% does not clear arm noise 5.69%

a_result_i_retracted.claimed_by_first_sweep: 149.5% of MLX at 1024 -- an outright win
a_result_i_retracted.why_it_was_refused: block2's IQR was 19.89%, failing the reliability gate, so compare() returned NO_CLAIM rather than a speedup
a_result_i_retracted.what_careful_measurement_showed: at 120 reps with 40 warmup, 1024 is 0.9999 -- EXACT PARITY, not a 1.5x win. MLX itself measured 3963 GFLOP/s in the noisy run and 5801 in the clean one, so the apparent win was MLX being under-measured.
a_result_i_retracted.lesson: the most exciting number in the sweep was the least trustworthy one, and the gate caught it before it became a claim

verdict.reason: an arm failed the 10.0% IQR gate (mlx 4.99%, block2 12.25%) and the margin 2.39% does not overwhelm that noise
margin 0.01% does not clear arm noise 5.16%

trustworthy_standing.1024: INDISTINGUISHABLE from MLX (0.9999, both arms under 5.2% IQR)
trustworthy_standing.512: NO CLAIM -- block2 IQR 12.25% even at 120 reps

claim_boundary: AIR's blocked simdgroup matmul reaches PARITY with MLX at 1024 and 2048 and LOSES by 24% at 4096. Parity is not victory and is not claimed as one; MLX remains the qualified winner, and at the largest size measured it still wins outright. f32 only, square shapes, dimensions multiples of 16 for block=2, no batching, no transpose, no mixed precision, and nothing was run inside a model.

bench.machine: Apple M3 Ultra, 60 GPU cores, 96 GiB (receipts/headless/MACHINE_GENOME.json)
bench.rule: S032 §3 -- if quiescence is unknown the state is UNKNOWN, not quiet
bench.provenance: this receipt was written before quiescence was a benchmark input and recorded none. UNKNOWN is what it measured under, not a claim that the machine was busy
